text: Pete the barista made my oat milk cortado perfectly. The almond croissant was flaky and delicious.
The mocha latte was overpriced and lukewarm. The wifi kept dropping, so I couldn't get any work done.
I love the comfortable seating by the window, but the music is way too loud. Patty at the register was quick even with a long line.
The cold brew was smooth and delicious. The blueberry scone was dry and stale. Tally at the register forgot my order.
Best mocha latte in Syracuse! The new murals make the place feel cozy, and Otto always says hi.
